name: Dogmeat

features.text: Ownership, naming, handler permissions and private projection foundations.
Native persistence/lifecycle pairing diagnostics with test carrier.
German Shepherd and English Mastiff editable model development.
Playable dog care, bonding, training and tasks.
Authenticated ownership/admission and exclusive native-control contracts unresolved.

Original Shepherd and both supplied coat variations use one raccoon hierarchy with unchanged geometry/UVs. Original dog-pivot clips and independent action/animation graphs correct the offline gait candidate. Vanilla raccoons and test carrier are unchanged.

Optional local tail-health presentation reads native replicated health under a server sandbox setting; unknown/disabled stays neutral. No health writes or ownership/task activation. Offline tested only.
